title: Patriots don't expect Ben Brown, Alijah Vera-Tucker to play on Thursday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Patriots don't expect Ben Brown, Alijah Vera-Tucker to play on Thursday
sources.description: The Patriots saw three of their starting offensive linemen go down with injuries during last Sunday's win over the Jets and it looks like they'll be without at least two of them when they face the Bears on Thursday.
